caption:
my living room passed the equipment check

#workout #fitnessapp #soma

slides.text:
No gym today

I scanned the living room

A mat, two dumbbells,
a sofa edge

That's equipment

One photo

It saw more than I did

Twenty minutes

Built for the room,
not for a gym I wasn't in

Home counts

The plan meets
the room you're in

slides.heading: Train where you are
slides.body: SOMA turns a photo of any space into a real session — gym floor, hotel corner, or your living room
